conflicts: Official address sources disagree. itour gives 차이나타운로26번길 12-17 (modified 2026-03-03). The KTO English page gives 차이나타운로59번길 20. Both are now listed as claims; pick one as the main address.

KTO page vcontsId=34369 lists 10:00~17:00 with Mondays closed. itour 개항장 거리 (modified 2026-09-22) lists 상시 개방 and 연중무휴. The KTO page also links the old Jung-gu website (icjg.go.kr, which did not respond), and its English address (269 Jemullyang-ro) differs from its Korean address (제물량로218번길 3). It shows no update date and may be stale.

ic-chinatown.co.kr is the homepage listed on itour, but it says it is run by a citizen ('시민이 운영'). It still uses the old 중구 names and directions such as 인천역 1번 출구 150m. It is not a primary source and its admin names are stale.
incheon.go.kr page 2187729 describes the 2026-07-01 reorganisation in the future tense, so it was written before the change took effect.

conflicts: Two official pages on the temple layout disagree. menu01501 says 중로전 is led by 대광명전 and 하로전 is centred on 영산전. menu01501_01 says 중로전 is led by 해장보각 and lists 하로전 as 극락보전·영산전 등. The description's '해장보각 중심의 중로전' follows only menu01501_01.

The English page (/eng/) is undated and may be stale. It still promotes the Tongdosa Museum, which the Korean page says is closed until construction is finished (planned 2026-12). Its Busan bus details are not on the Korean page.
The museum entry (c10) is a future plan ('2026년 12월 준공예정') and must be re-checked after December 2026.

notes: I opened every cited URL directly with curl and judged only the visible text, with comments and scripts stripped. Three itour or incheon.go.kr pages needed retries after the connection reset.
Corrections: Chinatown c1 (not stated to be the 패루 location), c5 (the course passes 인천근대건축전시관), c9 (collector's guess removed); Tongdosa c6 (Gyeongju bus wording).
Chinatown has two different official addresses (itour 26번길 12-17 vs KTO 59번길 20) and different hours (상시 개방 vs 10:00~17:00, Monday closed). One main value needs to be chosen.

The collector's unconfirmed items stay open: fees and payment for Chinatown and Wolmi, fountain show times, visit duration, and Korean audio guide. My lookups found no official values. icjg.go.kr did not respond, and ic-chinatown.co.kr is citizen-run (secondary) and still uses old 중구 names.
Page modification dates: itour Chinatown 2026-03-03, 개항장 거리 2026-09-22, Wolmi 2026-07-01. The KTO pages and Tongdosa pages show no update date.
